title.narrative: Inclusive Markets for Energy Efficiency in Uganda -Phase 2
Inclusive Markets for Energy Efficiency in Uganda-Phase 2

description.narrative:
The IMEU-II goal is to improve the livelihoods of households and increase the resilience and competitiveness of businesses and Social Institutions (SI) through the scaled adoption of EE technologies and practices.
The project aims to achieve the following objectives:
1. Create a strong, diverse, and sustainable Supply ecosystem for quality EE products and services.
2. Increase access to EE products and services for businesses, households, and institutions
3. Strengthen the Policy, regulatory, and institutional framework for the growth of EE markets
These are explained below:
Supply side: At the supply side, IMEU-II will focus on strengthening the supply ecosystem for quality EE products and services to ensure they are sustainable. Specifically, the interventions at the supply side will enhance Energy Service Provider Companies (ESPCs) capacity to market, distribute, and provide after-sales support for EE products and services. Additionally, IMEU-II will enhance Businesses and Social Institutions access to affordable and patient financing for EE products and services which will in turn increase the availability of quality EE products and services for households, businesses, and social institutions.
Demand side: IMEU-II aims at increasing the adoption and effective use of EE solutions among households, businesses, and social institutions, and strengthening the technical and institutional capacity of businesses and social institutions to adopt and maintain EE technologies and practice. This will be archived mainly through awareness creation on EE benefits, energy audits, Trainings in EE and energy management.
Enabling environment: IMEU-II will consolidate the gains of IMEU-1 and further aim to improve multi-stakeholder coordination and collaboration across EE ecosystem actors. This is to drive coherent policy and market development and enhance access to and use of reliable EE sector data and evidence for policy formulation and investment among EE stakeholders. The details of the planned outputs and activities of the project are provided in the implementation workplan.
